mode: Built-in image_gen; six element material atlases; technical tile extraction/resampling uses .NET, no procedural artwork.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Minecraft block texture ATLAS, one unified image containing EIGHT square flat texture tiles, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, equal tiles touching with NO gutters NO borders NO margins NO labels. Entire canvas aspect ratio 2:1 landscape, ideally 2048x1024. This is a FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC MATERIAL ATLAS, NO perspective, NO 3D cubes, NO scene, NO text. Row-major LIGHT to DARK order: top row shades 1 2 3 4, bottom row 5 6 7 8. Each tile has the same cohesive element motif and carving scale, shade progressively darker, distinct at small sizes. Each tile fills its own square edge to edge and should tile seamlessly with itself. Crisp stylized hand-painted fantasy Minecraft material, chunky readable bevels and carvings at 128px, moderate fine details, not photorealistic noise. Even neutral diffuse lighting, shallow bevels, no cast shadows, no vignette. Material occupies >=90%, accent channels <=8%. Keep all eight tile shapes square, aligned precisely at quarter widths and half height. Theme: Earth rock-armored titan: nested diamond earth-core runes, interlocking layered angular rock armor plates, fine aged gold mineral seams. Eight stone shades from ivory sand, pale beige, warm greige, taupe, umber, dark slate, charcoal basalt, to near-black basalt. Keep recognizable carved diamond core on every tile.
